Will James, Smoky the Cowhorse.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/will-james/smoky-the-cowhorse

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Will James, the author, died 1942.

First publication of the text used: 1926 (SE colophon: 'Smoky, the Cowhorse was published in 1926 by Will James.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1926, before 1931. Under the United States 95-year rule, every publication of 1930 or earlier has been in the public domain since 1 January 2026 at the latest.
- Country of origin: the facts do not point to any country as the country of first publication. The possible countries for an English text by these authors are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each of them has a term of life + 70 years or less for these deaths, so an unknown country, or a simultaneous publication in two of them, changes nothing. The last person to die died in 1942, so the text entered the public domain in each of these countries by 1 January 2013.
